description: This file defines the DelegateAsyncTimer class, which implements the IAsyncTimer interface. It provides a delegate-based asynchronous timer with methods for scheduling next ticks, health checks, and disposal tracking.
external_methods: bool CheckHealth(DateTime lastCheckTime, out string reason)

classes.name: DelegateAsyncTimer
classes.description: A delegate-based implementation of IAsyncTimer for testing or custom timing logic.

methods.name: DelegateAsyncTimer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the timer with a delegate function for scheduling the next tick.

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Invokes the delegate to determine if the timer should continue and when.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Increments the disposal counter, indicating the timer has been disposed.
